---
title: "Gridded climate comparison"
---

# Setup

```{r}
library(conflicted)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(stars)

conflict_prefer("filter", "dplyr")

sites <- read.csv("Data/sample_dates.csv") |> 
  distinct(site, longitude, latitude)

points <- sites |> 
  st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326)
```

# Extract climate data

## WorldClim

```{r}
# download from https://geodata.ucdavis.edu/climate/worldclim/2_1/base/wc2.1_2.5m_bio.zip

temp_wc <- read_stars("Data/worldclim/wc2.1_2.5m_bio_1.tif")

prec_wc <- read_stars("Data/worldclim/wc2.1_2.5m_bio_12.tif")
```

# CHELSA

```{r}
#https://os.unil.cloud.switch.ch/chelsa02/chelsa/global/bioclim/bio01/1981-2010/CHELSA_bio01_1981-2010_V.2.1.tif

temp_ch <- read_stars("Data/chelsa/CHELSA_bio01_1981-2010_V.2.1.tif")

#https://os.unil.cloud.switch.ch/chelsa02/chelsa/global/bioclim/bio12/1981-2010/CHELSA_bio12_1981-2010_V.2.1.tif

prec_ch <- read_stars("Data/chelsa/CHELSA_bio12_1981-2010_V.2.1.tif")
```

## Extract values

```{r}
clim <- sites |> 
  rename_with(str_to_sentence) |> 
  mutate(`Annual mean temperature (°C) WorldClim` = st_extract(temp_wc, points)[[1]] |> 
           round(2),
         `Annual mean temperature (°C) CHELSA` = st_extract(temp_ch, points)[[1]] |> 
           round(2),
         `Annual precipitation (mm) WorldClim` = st_extract(prec_wc, points)[[1]],
         `Annual precipitation (mm) CHELSA` = st_extract(prec_ch, points)[[1]])
```

# Measured weather

The full OFD weather dataset is used, disregarding survey years, keeping years with 12 months of data.

```{r}
vars <- c("air_t_mean_OFD", "precipitation_OFD")

weather <- read_rds("intermediate/weat.rds") |> 
  select(site, year, month, all_of(vars))

#there are a few cases where the two variables are not missing at the same time
weather[which(xor(is.na(weather$air_t_mean_OFD), is.na(weather$precipitation_OFD))),]

#hence create a complete tibble for each
months <- weather |> 
  summarise(across(all_of(vars), \(x) sum(!is.na(x))), .by = c(site, year)) 

#site-years with 11 or 12 months
keep <- map(vars, \(x) {
  months |>
    filter(.data[[x]] == 12) |> 
    select(site, year)
  }) |> 
  set_names(vars)

#subset data
complete <- keep |> 
  imap(\(x, idx) weather |>
        select(site, year, month, all_of(idx)) |> 
        semi_join(x, by = c("site", "year")))

#annual means
complete <- complete |> 
  imap(\(x, idx) if(str_detect(idx, "precipitation")){
    #sum precipitation
    x |> 
      summarise("{idx}" := sum(.data[[idx]]),
                   .by = c(site, year)) |> 
      #then site mean
      summarise("{idx}" := mean(.data[[idx]]),
                .by = site)
  } else {
    #average temperature
    #12 months each year, so single step
    x |> 
         summarise("{idx}" := mean(.data[[idx]]),
                   .by = site)
  })

#add to table
clim <- clim |> 
  mutate(`Annual mean temperature (°C) measured` = complete$air_t_mean_OFD$air_t_mean_OFD |> 
           round(2),
         .after = 5) |>
  mutate(`Annual precipitation (mm) measured` = complete$precipitation_OFD$precipitation_OFD |> 
           round(0))

clim

write_csv(clim, "output/clim_comparison.csv")
```
